name: Quansheng ALERT receiver (UV-K5 V3 / UV-K1)
tagline: ALERT flood-telemetry receiver firmware for the Quansheng UV-K5 V3 and UV-K1, a fork of F4HWN.
about: A fork of the F4HWN firmware for the PY32F071 radios that adds an ALERT receiver app: it demodulates the 300-baud bursts on 151.5 MHz in software, decodes them, names the station from a table generated from Flood-Net's station list, logs to SPI flash and talks to a computer over USB-C. Our work is the app (App/app/alert_*), its host tools (tools/alert/, tools/hotflash.py), filters/ and docs/ALERT_SERIAL.md; everything else is upstream F4HWN. People get it through the quansheng_alert_ALL installer, and Flood-Net and RPi ALERT read it over serial.

status.summary: Receiver v2 decodes on air (22 of 22 bursts) and ships through quansheng_alert_ALL; no firmware work since 1 October, and its built-in station table is a month behind Flood-Net.
next: Regenerate the built-in station table: Flood-Net now gives 451 sites, not 443
Record which Flood-Net commit the built-in table was generated from
Drop A2C's zero status-byte check; Flood-Net reads it as a time offset (cdomotor-g/MegaNet#209)
Send quansheng_alert_ALL a firmware-updated dispatch after each push to main

components.name: ALERT receiver app
components.what: The app behind the ALERT menu entry: burst capture, the screens, settings, speaker and voice, and the CSV records.

components.name: Software AFSK demodulator
components.what: Reads the receiver audio on PA4 with the ADC and turns 1300/2100 Hz, 300-baud bursts into bits, sampled mid-bit.

components.name: Frame decoder
components.what: Finds ABF and EIF frames in the bits (and decodes A2C records) by Flood-Net's packets.js layouts, with the idle gate and CRC-6.

components.name: Station table
components.what: A built-in table of 443 South-East Queensland sites generated from Flood-Net, plus a fuller table that can be uploaded to SPI flash.

components.name: SPI flash log
components.what: A ring log of every decode in SPI flash, kept clear of the radio's voice clips and read back over USB.

components.name: USB serial interface
components.what: Text console and records over USB-C (schema 2): HDR, DEC, BST, STA, EVT, settings, log dump, station upload and screen capture.

components.name: Host tools
components.what: alertterm.py (the reference client), hotflash.py for flashing over USB-C, and the capture, simulation and layout checks.

components.name: CI build and checks
components.what: Builds the RescueOps image with ENABLE_ALERT=ON, confirms the app is in it, and runs the decoder, layout and menu-wiring checks.

components.name: F4HWN base firmware
components.what: Upstream F4HWN Fusion port for the PY32F071 by muzkr and armel (Apache-2.0); the ALERT app hooks into its menu, keys and settings.

provides.name: ALERT firmware source (RescueOps build)
provides.what: The source quansheng_alert_ALL compiles every week: cmake --preset RescueOps -DENABLE_ALERT=ON gives build/RescueOps/f4hwn.rescueops.bin.

provides.name: ALERT serial interface, schema 2
provides.what: What the radio sends and accepts on USB-C: line format, records, DTR rule, console commands, screen capture. Flood-Net's quansheng.js and RPi ALERT implement it.

provides.name: SPI station-table blob
provides.what: The ASTB table format uploaded with the console's STN commands (section 8); Flood-Net's Serial Radio tab builds the same blob.

provides.name: alertterm.py
provides.what: Reference client: live table, log download as CSV, station upload, screenshots, console. The setup guide tells people to run it.

provides.name: Screen captures
provides.what: PNG captures of the v2 screens taken from the radio over SCREEN; the setup guide shows copies.

consumes.what: Station names, sensor kinds, ALERT addresses and repeater networks for the built-in table.
consumes.on_change: python3 tools/alert/gen_stations.py --meganet-dir ../MegaNet --filter filters/stations.filter --out App/app/alert_stations_gen.h (8000-byte limit), then build and push. No Flood-Net commit is recorded: the header points at docs/firmware/manifest.json, which this repository does not have.

consumes.what: alertterm.py stations-upload reads Flood-Net's station files from main at run time to build the SPI table.
consumes.on_change: Nothing to rebuild. If the files' layout changes (sensors, alert_ids, radio_networks), fix the parsers in tools/alert/gen_stations.py.

consumes.what: The ABF, EIF and A2C bit layouts and the CRC-6, mirrored bit for bit from packets.js FORMATS.
consumes.on_change: Compare packets.js FORMATS with App/app/alert_decode.c; mirror any change and add a vector to tools/alert/test_decode.c.

consumes.what: The README sends people to the setup guide and to the installer at /flash/?radio=v3.
consumes.on_change: Check the README's links to the guide and the installer still land.
